subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

rationale: The remaining fix choice affects SSRF enforcement, DNS pinning, Undici dispatcher behavior, and Microsoft Graph auth; automation cannot safely choose that security boundary without maintainer intent and live proof.

options.title: Live-repro narrow guarded repair
